hcg_threshold_gain.note: lowest gain of the high-conversion-gain branch; the fine grid steps by 2, which is the uncertainty.  ZWO's own published curve annotates 200 (vendor/asi585specs/) and the retired project measured 200 -- one prediction, not two, and this reproduces it.  The 'ZWO say 252' belief has no source; 252 is the ASI2600's threshold (L26)

read_noise_at_hcg.note: pair-difference sigma / sqrt(2), mean over four CFA planes (L10)

project_offset.note: the offset this project fixes on and does not sweep again.  A decision, not a measurement, which is why the uncertainty is 0: 10 is the smallest the evidence supports (offset_min_safe) and 15 costs 0.49% more of full scale for it.  Bought: headroom, and commensurability with the 15,090 archive frames, all shot at 15 (L13)

offset_min_safe.note: smallest offset passing both tests at every judged gain (0-300): clipped fraction under 0.1% (L13) and at least 15 R of headroom above the floor.  Its own worst headroom is 19.6 R.  The headroom floor is bracketed by measurement, not picked -- offset 5 clips at 13.5 R and offset 10 does not at 19.6 R -- and the arm steps by 5, which is the uncertainty on both. Gain 600 is excluded and published separately: its zero floor survives every offset, so it is telegraph noise, not clipping (L13)

offset_zero_clipping.note: why offset 0 is rejected, measured rather than assumed: at gain 0 the pedestal is 2.74 counts, only 4.2 R above the floor, and this fraction of pixels is pinned there.  The uncertainty field carries what a Gaussian of that width would put below the zero code; measured is 1.7x that, and the excess is the non-Gaussian low tail.  It passes a 0.1% test and is still unusable

bias_fixed_pattern_ratio.note: one frame's pixel-to-pixel spread over the pair-difference R, at offset 15, across 77 gains.  At 1.0 the bias carries no fixed pattern worth a master beyond a scalar pedestal -- and it licenses R as the yardstick for the clipping headroom, which is otherwise an assumption

pedestal_per_offset_unit.note: the digital term A; L27 predicts ~4.0 and gain-independent

pedestal_fit.note: pedestal = A + B * 10**(gain/200), fitted per conversion-gain branch, split at gain 200; uncertainty is the worst residual (L27)

pedestal_drift_rate.note: gain 100, offset 15, 450 frames over 15 min at -10 C

bias_exposure.note: the camera's minimum exposure, read from the Exposure control

setpoint.note: held in band for a continuous 30 s before the first frame, and every frame outside +/-0.5 C retaken rather than written; uncertainty is the band, which is also the sensor's own quantisation
